input.title: 2025 Hobie Mirage Outback
input.descriptionHtml:
Financing Available!*

Book a FREE On-Water Demo!

Meet the 2025 Hobie Mirage Outbackan iconic kayak redefined for anglers and adventurers who demand versatility, stability, and performance. Packed with advanced features designed to enhance your time on the water, the Outback delivers the ideal balance of agility and durability for any environment, whether you're fishing remote waters or exploring scenic coastlines.
 

Top-Tier Features for Serious Adventurers:

  • MirageDrive 180 with Kick-Up Turbo Fins: Effortlessly maneuver in any direction with Hobie's MirageDrive 180, featuring Kick-Up Turbo Fins that automatically retract upon impact, allowing you to tackle shallow waters and submerged obstacles without worry.
  • Adjustable Vantage CTW Seat: Enjoy all-day comfort with the spacious and supportive Vantage CTW seat. Its adjustable design offers custom positioning for maximized comfort during long outings.
  • Guardian Retractable Transducer Shield: Perfect for anglers, the Guardian transducer system provides superior sonar protection, keeping your equipment safe while still allowing for full functionality on the water.
  • Ample Storage Options: The Outback comes equipped with multiple storage hatches, a large bow hatch, and an easily accessible rear cargo area with bungee tie-downs, giving you plenty of space for gear, tackle, and all your essentials.
  • Integrated H-Track Rails: Outfit your kayak with the gear you need for fishing or exploration, thanks to the built-in H-Track rails, which provide flexible mounting options for rods, fish finders, and other accessories.
  • Kick-Up Rudder: Experience precise steering and enhanced stability with Hobie's Kick-Up Rudder system, designed to retract on impact and then automatically redeploy, making it easy to navigate in challenging conditions.
 

Specifications at a Glance:

  • Length: 12'9" (3.89 m)
  • Width: 34" (0.86 m)
  • Fitted Hull Weight: 85 lbs (38.56 kg)
  • Fully Rigged Weight: 103 lbs (46.72 kg)
  • Capacity: 425 lbs (192.78 kg)
  • Drive: MirageDrive 180 with Kick-Up Turbo Fins
  • Hull Material: Rotomolded Polyethylene
 

Designed for Exploration and Angling Excellence

The Hobie Mirage Outback is renowned for its stability, making it the ideal choice for anglers who need a reliable and smooth platform for casting and reeling. Its rugged construction and innovative features ensure that this kayak will keep up with your adventures, no matter where they take you. From the integrated fishfinder shield to spacious storage, the Outback has everything you need to stay organized, safe, and comfortable on the water.

Discover why the Hobie Mirage Outback is a top pick among enthusiasts
